top_signals.title: July CPI Crucial as Inflation Rebound Concerns Rise
top_signals.summary: Barclays US economist Pooja Sriram discussed expectations for the upcoming July Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, emphasizing that the recent softer inflation reading in June is likely to be short-lived. She noted that while the July CPI data may not be decisive on its own, it remains a critical data point for markets and policymakers, especially following last Friday's relatively soft payrolls report which eased concerns about a reacceleration in economic activity. Sriram highlighted that inflation data will play a key role in shaping expectations ahead of the Federal Reserve's next meeting, with all eyes on whether inflation rebounds as anticipated. The segment underscored the significance of CPI and PPI data as the next major test for the Fed's policy direction. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
